1. Use the `PimaIndiansDiabetes` dataset. Use 15% data for testing. Use cross-validation with of 7 folds to tune random forest `(method='ranger')`.  What are the parameters that produce the greatest accuracy? What is the testing accuracy. 

```{r}
library(caret)
library(mlbench)
library(tidyverse)
data(PimaIndiansDiabetes)
df <- tibble(PimaIndiansDiabetes)


df <- df %>% rename(target=diabetes)
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(target = as.factor(target))
splitIndex <- createDataPartition(df$target, p = .85, 
                                  list = FALSE)
df_train <- df[ splitIndex,]
df_test <- df[-splitIndex,]


# 7 fold cross validation 
tuneGrid = expand.grid(maxdepth = 2:10)
# Tell caret to do Approach 2. Cross-Validation
trControl = trainControl(method = "cv",
                         number = 7)
# Do Approach 2 
tree_approach2 <- train(target~., data=df_train, 
                                method = "rpart2", 
                                trControl = trControl,
                                tuneGrid = tuneGrid)

# Plot the results
plot(tree_approach2)
print(tree_approach2)


pred <- predict(tree_approach2, df_test)
cm <- confusionMatrix(data = pred, reference = df_test$target, positive = "pos")
cm$overall[1]

getModelInfo('ranger')$ranger$parameters


trControl = trainControl(method = "cv",
                         number = 7)
tuneGrid = expand.grid(mtry = 2:4,
                       splitrule = c('gini', 'extratrees'),
                       min.node.size = c(1:10))
forest_ranger <- train(target~., data=df_train, 
                    method = "ranger", 
                    trControl = trControl,
                    tuneGrid = tuneGrid)
plot(forest_ranger)

#Accuracy
pred <- predict(forest_ranger, df_test)
cm <- confusionMatrix(data = pred, reference = df_test$target, positive = "pos")
cm$overall[1]
```


2. Use the `PimaIndiansDiabetes` dataset. Go to https://topepo.github.io/caret/available-models.html and pick a classification model.  Tune the classification model using cross-validation of 7 folds. 

```{r}
library(mlbench)
library(caret)

# Load data
data(PimaIndiansDiabetes)

# Make sure target is a factor
PimaIndiansDiabetes$target <- as.factor(PimaIndiansDiabetes$diabetes)

# Remove original response variable if needed
df <- PimaIndiansDiabetes[, c("pregnant", "glucose", "pressure",
                              "triceps", "insulin", "mass",
                              "pedigree", "age", "target")]

# Train/Test split
set.seed(123)
splitIndex <- createDataPartition(df$target, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

df_train <- df[splitIndex, ]
df_test  <- df[-splitIndex, ]

# 7-fold cross-validation
ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 7
)

# Tune SVM Radial model
set.seed(123)
svm_model <- train(
  target ~ .,
  data = df_train,
  method = "svmRadial",
  trControl = ctrl,
  preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
  tuneLength = 10
)

# View best tuning parameters
svm_model
plot(svm_model)

# Predictions on test data
pred <- predict(svm_model, newdata = df_test)

# Confusion matrix and accuracy
cm <- confusionMatrix(pred, df_test$target)
cm

# Accuracy
cm$overall["Accuracy"]
```


3. (Model Comparison) Use the `PimaIndiansDiabetes` dataset. Pick two models at [this link](https://topepo.github.io/caret/available-models.html) to compare using 7-fold cross validation method. Evaluate the accuracy of the final model on the test data. 


```{r}
library(mlbench)
library(caret)

# Load data
data(PimaIndiansDiabetes)

df <- PimaIndiansDiabetes

# Train/Test Split
set.seed(123)

splitIndex <- createDataPartition(
  df$diabetes,
  p = 0.8,
  list = FALSE
)

df_train <- df[splitIndex, ]
df_test  <- df[-splitIndex, ]

# 7-Fold Cross Validation
ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 7
)

# Model 1: KNN
set.seed(123)
knn_model <- train(
  diabetes ~ .,
  data = df_train,
  method = "knn",
  trControl = ctrl,
  preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
  tuneLength = 10
)

# Model 2: SVM Radial
set.seed(123)
svm_model <- train(
  diabetes ~ .,
  data = df_train,
  method = "svmRadial",
  trControl = ctrl,
  preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
  tuneLength = 10
)

# Compare Cross-Validation Results
resamps <- resamples(list(
  KNN = knn_model,
  SVM = svm_model
))

summary(resamps)

# Plot comparison
bwplot(resamps)
```
